MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The HDMI cable was the closest match because I have bought a display cable before, and connecting equipment fits my practical accessory purchases.",
    "The cable recommendation partly recognized my interest in useful connection accessories, although I would only choose it if I had a specific HDMI connection to make."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo devices and Fire TV products do not solve a need I have identified; buying computer adapters does not mean I want voice assistants or TV streaming equipment.",
    "The memory cards require a storage need I have not shown, and my earlier headset purchase does not mean I need replacement earbuds now.",
    "My small-tablet mount served a different purpose from mounting a large television, so the TV wall mount felt unrelated to what I needed."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations treated electronics as broadly interchangeable, while the particular connection or task matters much more to me.",
    "An earlier headset or mount purchase seemed to imply interest in other headphones or mounts without accounting for the device involved or whether I needed another one."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Several of my purchases help computers connect to networks, peripherals, or displays; that practical purpose matters more than simply being an electronic device.",
    "My purchases are spread over years, and I rarely interact without a concrete need, so a related past purchase alone is not enough to make me choose something now.",
    "The specific ports and equipment matter: a DVI cable purchase gives only limited reason to expect that I need an HDMI cable."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in electronics but missed that I choose specific accessories to solve concrete connection needs."
}
